details.description: Code Llama - Python 70B is the largest Python-specialized model in Meta's Code Llama family, further trained on Python code on top of the 70B base checkpoint. Meta fine-tuned it with sequences of up to 16k tokens; it does not support the up-to-100k-token long-context handling of some sibling variants, and it does not support infilling, instruction-following, or chat -- it is a raw completion model. Training ran between January 2023 and January 2024. Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived (read-only) on July 1, 2025, and Code Llama is absent from Meta's current model documentation, which now centers on newer Llama releases.
advantages: Scores 57.3% pass@1 on HumanEval and 65.6% pass@1 on MBPP, the strongest results among the Code Llama - Python sizes (Meta's Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Largest Code Llama Python model, at 70 billion parameters.
disadvantages: Does not support infilling, instruction-following, or chat; Meta's model card lists only code completion for this variant.
Does not support the up-to-100k-token long context available for some other Code Llama variants.
Trained only on data collected through January 2024.
Meta's Code Llama GitHub repository was archived in July 2025 and the family is absent from Meta's current model documentation.
use_cases: Python-specific code completion for large or complex codebases.
Base model for further fine-tuning on Python coding tasks.

notes: Bud's catalog gives a 4096-token input/output limit for this model, but Meta's model card says it was fine-tuned with sequences of up to 16k tokens (and does not support the up-to-100k long context of some Code Llama variants); kept the catalog's 4096 value per instructions. Bud also serves this as 'chat' kind, but Meta's card states this variant supports only code completion, not instructions or chat.
